positions.label: Rabanastre
tips: PS2 original: never open the chest outside Old Dalan's place in Lowtown — it is the first of four that delete the Zodiac Spear. Sign with Clan Centurio; start Ktjn's three-talk chain in the Muthru Bazaar.
Zodiac Age: pick jobs deliberately; the second job comes later and resets exist only on newer platforms.

positions.label: Giza Plains & Garamsythe
tips: The palace treasury cellar during the heist holds cursed chests two and three (PS2). Walk past them.

positions.label: Nalbina & Barheim Passage
tips: The Confiscatory in Nalbina's dungeons is cursed chest four (PS2). Barheim reopens later with the key from the Estersand errands — Zalera waits in the deep tunnels.

positions.label: Bhujerba & the Lhusu Mines
tips: Talk to Ktjn again once you are back in Rabanastre. Nothing in the mines closes; Gilgamesh comes much later.

positions.label: The Leviathan
tips: One visit. Open what you pass on the dreadnought; the chests are ordinary but unrepeatable.

positions.label: Ogir-Yensa & Raithwall's Tomb
tips: The optional Demon Wall in the tomb's first hall can only be fought now. Zertinan Caverns (Adrammelech) opens from the sandsea's sinkholes.

positions.label: Jahara & Eruyt Village
tips: Ktjn's third conversation is available after the tomb — her reward is set by your answers.

positions.label: Henne Mines
tips: The special charter shaft (Zodiark; the Zodiac Age spear chest) unlocks much later from the Geomancer in Jahara.

positions.label: Mt Bur-Omisace
tips: Nothing closes. The Stone of the Condemner for Zeromus comes from an acolyte here late in the story.

positions.label: Stilshrine of Miriam
tips: Revisitable. Zeromus is reached from the shrine's waystone once you hold the Stone of the Condemner.

positions.label: Mosphoran & the Salikawood
tips: The Necrohol of Nabudis is through the Salikawood's northeast gate: the Zodiac Spear (PS2, if the pact held) and Chaos behind the medallion doors. Exodus sits atop the Mosphoran shrine.

positions.label: Phon Coast
tips: The beach chest cluster on the Phon Coast is the last cursed spot (PS2). The Hunt Club opens at the Hunters' Camp — decide which brother you favor.

positions.label: Tchita Uplands & Sochen
tips: The Sluice Gate Key (White Mousse hunt) opens the Garamsythe channels for Cúchulainn. Gilgamesh's duels in the Lhusu Mines are open from here.

positions.label: Archades
tips: Trade chops for pinewood to reach the upper city. Nothing here closes.

positions.label: Draklor Laboratory
tips: One visit — the laboratory is sealed after the story. Sweep every floor before the elevator scenes.

positions.label: Giruvegan
tips: The Great Crystal above Giruvegan holds Ultima and Omega Mark XII. Zodiark's shaft is open once most espers are claimed.

positions.label: Ridorana & the Pharos
tips: Yiazmat appears at the cataract once the board is clear. The Pharos's third ascent asks you to forfeit an ability temporarily — pick the one you miss least.

positions.label: The Sky Fortress Bahamut
tips: The game warns you: there is no turning back once you board. Finish every hunt, esper and trade first, then sweep the fortress.

items.name: Leave the four cursed chests closed
items.location: Lowtown · Palace cellar · Nalbina · Phon Coast

route.why: Opening ANY of these four chests silently deletes the Zodiac Spear from the game

steps: Lowtown — the chest outside Old Dalan's place
Palace treasury cellar — the chests during the heist
Phon Coast — the beach chest cluster
items.notes: Tick each one off as you walk past it untouched. Mark the whole item collected once you're past the Phon Coast.

items.name: Zodiac Spear

route.why: The strongest weapon in the game, in a plain unguarded chest — if you kept the pact

items.notes: Enter Nabudis through the Salikawood's northeast gate. The chest sits in the Cloister of the Highborn.

items.name: Zodiac Spear (Henne Mines)
items.notes: Zodiac Age removed the cursed-chest pact; the spear is instead a low-odds chest deep in the Henne Mines (better odds with the Diamond Armlet). No pact required — just persistence.

items.name: Job assignments
items.location: Job board — each character's first board, then the second job
items.notes: Twelve boards, two per character. Original Zodiac Age releases lock the choice; PS4 1.04+, Switch, Xbox and PC allow a reset at the Clan Hall. Plan pairs before committing.

refs.label: Zodiac Age job guide on the FF wiki

items.name: Ktjn the viera — three conversations
steps: First talk — before leaving for Nalbina
Second talk — after returning from Bhujerba
Third talk — after Raithwall's Tomb; the answers decide her reward

route.why: Three short chats spread across half the story

items.notes: Her final gift depends on how you answered. The pack closes the chain before Draklor pessimistically — verify the real cutoff.

items.name: The Leviathan sweep
items.notes: Ordinary chests, but nothing aboard can be revisited.

items.name: The optional Demon Wall

route.why: Stand your ground in the first hall — it never returns

items.notes: Fight the first wall instead of fleeing to unlock the chest behind it (the Demonsbane in Zodiac Age). Tough this early; a Quickening chain helps.

items.name: Adrammelech
items.notes: The Wroth reachable from Ogir-Yensa's sinkholes. Undead swarm the arena — bring Curaja or phoenix downs to weaponize.

items.name: Zalera
steps: Finish the Dantro's Wife errand chain along the Nebra for the Barheim Key
Return through the Estersand to the deep tunnels
items.notes: The key chain starts with the wounded merchant in the Estersand.

items.name: Cúchulainn
items.notes: The White Mousse hunt yields the Sluice Gate Key; drain the right channels to reach the Impure. The gate puzzle is the real boss.

items.name: Exodus
items.notes: Free the shrine stones (weather-dependent floating paths) to reach the Judge-Sal.

items.name: Chaos
items.notes: The three medallions quest (Nabreus Deadlands relics) opens the sealed doors. Fought with magick only — Silence is death.

items.name: Zeromus
items.notes: An acolyte on Mt Bur-Omisace hands over the Stone of the Condemner late in the story; use it at the shrine's waystone. No MP inside.

items.name: Ultima
items.notes: The unmapped waystone maze above Giruvegan. Bring patience and a pen — the High Seraph waits at the top.

items.name: Zodiark
items.notes: Speak with the Geomancer in Jahara once most espers are claimed to open the special charter shaft. The hardest fight on this list.

items.name: Clan hunts & Montblanc's board

route.why: Sign with Clan Centurio early — hunts gate half the endgame

items.notes: Petitioner boards refresh as the story advances. Several petitioners vanish into later story states — clear the board when you can.

items.name: Phon Coast Hunt Club
items.notes: Thirty rare game trophies split between three brothers. How you split them decides the shop's stock — favor one brother deliberately.

items.name: Gilgamesh
items.notes: Two duels deep in the mines (Site 7 needs the site key). He brings every famous sword that isn't real.

items.name: Genji gear (steal from Gilgamesh)
steps: First duel — steal the Genji Gloves and Genji Armor at his health thresholds
Second duel — steal the Genji Helm and Genji Shield
items.notes: Glove, armor, helm and shield are STEAL-ONLY across the two fights — kill him without stealing and the set is gone. Steal at each health threshold.

items.name: Draklor Laboratory sweep

route.why: The lab is sealed after the story — one pass

items.notes: Use the floor switches to reach every room before the elevator scenes. Verify contents on your version.

items.name: Omega Mark XII
items.notes: Hidden in the crystal's second ascent. Drops nothing you need; exists to prove a point.

items.name: Yiazmat
items.notes: Unlocks after the rest of the board is clear. Fifty million HP. Bring a book.

items.name: Sky Fortress Bahamut sweep

route.why: No turning back once you board — the chests are one-pass

items.notes: Open every chest on the way to the bridge. Verify contents on your version.
